edit.description: A sibling of `collection_address_collision_diagnostics` (:685, which 21f61463 added for two *kinds* sharing one collectionAddress): two members of ONE kind composing to one member address are refused loud, naming every one of them. The subject is MEMBER IDENTITY (`member_address::host_address`), not the registration key — decisions 0063/0074 make a `GroupArray` collection many-members-per-key by construction, so three groups keyed `PostToolUse` are three legal members and only an identical (event, matcher) pair coincides. For the `Object` and `Scalar` entry shapes one key still is one member, so a duplicate key remains a duplicate identity there. `nested_member_coincidence` (:154) is the existing twin one grain down — same refusal class, same wording shape.

Wire the new diagnostic beside the existing `collection_address_collision_diagnostics` call and the three `nested_member_*` calls (:415-:431), which is where the lock's cross-family coherence is decided before the by-kind corpus is trusted.

Regression, and its twin: two groups on one event with the SAME authored matcher refuse loud naming both; two groups on one event with distinct matchers compose clean, so the refusal never rejects the legal harness the 09-03 revert proved it must admit. A third arm over `mcp-server` (an `Object` collection) pins that a duplicate key there still refuses. The suite is a module of the one `it` crate, so scaffolding is reached as `common::…` through `crate`.

summary: Two members of one kind composing to one member address are refused loud, rather than silently resolving to whichever was read last.

tests.asserts: two groups on one event with the same matcher refuse loud naming both, two groups with distinct matchers compose clean, and a duplicate key in an object-shaped collection still refuses

acceptance: Two members coinciding on one member address refuse at declaration time with a named error rather than silently composing to whichever was last, and the self-host check (tests/it/cli.rs:296) stays green over this repo's own surface.
notes: GH #32, rewritten twice. Unparked: both forks are ruled (0074, 0075) and the park's second half is verified moot — this repo's `.temper/lock.toml` names no hook member, and its three `PostToolUse` registration rows are legal under the group grain, so no human re-emit is owed. The subject moved from registration key to member identity; the first pick's event-only refusal is why. scoped at 079c105e
